subject: Request for one-off reactive credit & expiration grace — AtlasHealth POC
messages:
From: Sophia Wu <sophia.wu@atlashealth.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC credits + expiry — need a short extension

Hi Marcus,

Quick one — our pilot ran into a hold last week because one of our data connectors needed remediation. We burned through the initial sandbox fast once it restarted and the trial credits expired before we could finish the end-to-end validation.

Can Redwood do a one-off credit top-up (roughly 100k tokens) and push the expiration window out by 30 days so our engineering team has time to complete the remaining tests? We should be ready to move to a paid Dedicated eval afterwards if the remaining tests pass.

Attached a short scope doc and our usage export for context.

Thanks,
Sophia Wu
Head of Engineering, AtlasHealth
(sophia.wu@atlashealth.ai)

Attachments: atlas-poc-scope.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-usage-export-20260818.csv (text/csv)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Wu <sophia.wu@atlashealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC credits + expiry — need a short extension

Hi Sophia — thanks for the context and the files.

I can help get this moving. Quick clarifying Qs:
- Is the remaining work mostly inference (text generation/chat) or embedding-heavy?
- Will AtlasHealth need any data residency or special retention controls during the extended window?

Marissa — looping you in for credit approval and to coordinate the sandbox top-up/expiry change.

Sophia, if you can confirm the workload mix above, I’ll include the right ask in the internal approval note. We typically handle one-off top-ups for active demos, but need a brief internal sign-off for quota and expiry exceptions.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sophia Wu <sophia.wu@atlashealth.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC credits + expiry — need a short extension

Thanks Marcus —

Sophia: appreciate the quick scope file. For one-off credit requests we need the following to approve quickly:
- Confirmed token estimate (you requested ~100k tokens) and which API endpoints (generation vs embeddings) will be used.
- A short mutual action plan (MVP acceptance criteria and dates) so we can tie the top-up to progress cadence.
- Confirmation there are no special contractual terms required (e.g., health-data enclave / on-prem requirement) during the extension.

Assuming this is standard inference/embeddings and no special residency, we can approve a 100k token top-up and push expiration +30 days. Rishi, tagging you for pricing/discount guidance — if Atlas plans to convert to Dedicated quickly we can include a modest conversion incentive; want to confirm the deal signal before we apply.

Sophia — can you paste a 2–3 line acceptance criteria and estimated split (e.g., 70% generation / 30% embeddings)? That will let me set the tokens on the right routes.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sophia Wu <sophia.wu@atlashealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erik Jensen <erik.jensen@atlashealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 13:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC credits + expiry — need a short extension

Hi Marissa — thanks. Quick answers:
- Token split ~80% generation (multi-turn clinical note summarization) / 20% embeddings (semantic search). 100k tokens is our working estimate to finish validation.
- MVP acceptance: 1) end-to-end ingestion → anonymized summarization works for 95% of test cases; 2) embeddings similarity threshold met on a 50k-document test set; target completion by 2026-09-10.
- No special data residency requests for the sandbox; data is anonymized and stays in the staging environ.

If you can do +100k tokens and +30 days expiry that would cover our run. Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re close and want to avoid re-running the whole set.

Best,
Sophia
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC credits + expiry — need a short extension

Marissa / Marcus — approved from a commercial standpoint: one-off 100k token top-up and shift expiry +30 days. Conditions:
- Add a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) to the HubSpot deal record (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ATL-POC-42) by EOD 2026-08-20 with the acceptance criteria Sophia included.
- If Atlas converts to a 6–12 month Dedicated commitment within 45 days of acceptance, apply a one-time conversion credit equal to 10% of the top-up value.

Marissa — please action the sandbox credit and expiry change and attach the MAP and the 2 CSVs to the deal. Marcus — please tell Sophia we’ll flip the credits by EOD and include the MAP template in the follow-up.

—Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
